entities.name: Brago
entities.description: Spirit known as the King Eternal who ruled the High City of Paliano on Fiora; formerly Count Brago.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: High City of Fiora ruled by Brago.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: Priesthood that prolonged Brago's life and kept his spirit as a figurehead.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: Brago's good friend who ended his suffering with a dagger.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who finally killed Brago's spirit.

events.summary: Count Brago rises through the ruling class, building a coalition and gaining ever more power.
events.quote: He built up a coalition of nobility, clergy, and the merchant class.

events.summary: Three years after ascending the throne, Brago is diagnosed with an incurable disease and the Custodi prolong his life.
events.quote: only three years after he had ascended to the throne, he was diagnosed with a hereditary and incurable disease

events.summary: Selvala ends Brago's suffering with a dagger through his heart, releasing his spirit.
events.quote: Brago's good friend Selvala ended his suffering with a dagger through his heart.

events.summary: The Custodi keep Brago's spirit alive as a figurehead to retain their command.
events.quote: So they kept Brago’s spirit alive as a figurehead and were able to retain their command.

events.summary: Instigated by Marchesa, Brago's spirit is killed finally by Kaya.
events.quote: killed finally by the planeswalker Kaya

relations.note: Selvala stabbed Brago through the heart, releasing his spirit.
relations.quote: ended his suffering with a dagger through his heart
killed finally by the planeswalker Kaya

relations.note: They kept his spirit as figurehead to retain power.
relations.quote: The Custodi knew that they would lose power through the succession.
was a spirit that ruled the High City of Paliano on the plane of Fiora
